summary: Diff implements a new ChatRoomView and updates admin user listing/actions via a unified all-users query with mutations and UI scaffolding. However, some chat-request flow acceptance behaviors (especially opening the specific permanent 1:1 chat after accept) and parts of the UI-state requirements are not fully verifiable from the truncated diff, and at least one aspect appears inconsistent with the spec.

missing_requirements.requirement: After accepting a pending chat request, open the permanent private 1-to-1 chat room for that pair (message list + input) and ensure it remains accessible later.
missing_requirements.reason: ApprovedUsersListView navigates to '/chat' after accepting, but there is no evidence it navigates to the specific 1:1 chat room (e.g., passing a chatId) or that acceptance returns/uses the created chatId to open the correct conversation immediately. ChatScreen supports a chatId prop/route object, but the accept flow shown does not use it.

missing_requirements.requirement: Sender must ONLY see “Request Sent” after sending; receiver must see Accept/Reject ONLY for incoming pending requests.
missing_requirements.reason: The data filtering for incoming pending requests is present, but the diff is truncated before the rendering logic that proves (a) sender UI shows only “Request Sent” for pending sent requests and (b) Accept/Reject never appears for other statuses (accepted/rejected) or for non-receiver users.

missing_requirements.requirement: After rejection: sender clearly sees rejected state; re-send is blocked until 24h has elapsed based on Firestore timestamps.
missing_requirements.reason: There is a local helper canResendAfterReject(), but the diff is truncated before UI rendering that clearly shows a rejected state and disables/block re-send within 24h. The firebase wrapper is also truncated, so persisted (Firestore-based) enforcement is not directly verifiable from the shown code.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin Users rows must permanently show photo, name, email, phone number, and human-readable signup date/time derived from users.createdAt for every user.
missing_requirements.reason: AdminUsersScreen includes Avatar and a formatDate helper, and table headers for Email/Phone are shown, but the file is truncated before the table body rendering that confirms all required fields (including signup date/time, not just date) are displayed in-row for every user/status.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin ALWAYS sees full list of users (approved + unapproved/pending + rejected + blocked) in existing /admin/users without filters/toggles, preserving existing Admin layout/guard.
missing_requirements.reason: AdminUsersScreen appears to use getAllUsers via useFirestoreUsersList and wraps with AdminRouteGuard/AdminLayout, but the file is truncated before confirming there are no filter toggles and that all statuses are included unconditionally in the rendered list.

missing_requirements.requirement: Changes must be verifiably visible in Draft preview for admin users list and chat request behaviors.
missing_requirements.reason: Some core behaviors are not fully verifiable from the truncated render code (ApprovedUsersListView and AdminUsersScreen), and the accept->open-specific-chat behavior appears incomplete, so Draft verifiability for all AC items is not demonstrated by the diff summary alone.

hallucinated_features.description: Added verbose console logging in the AppHeader (userProfile/authUser bindings and display source).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; BuildRequest emphasizes minimal, scoped changes and avoiding touching working parts beyond required fixes.
